what: every count behind ATLAS.md: whole-tree statistics, string counts, and the ledger file
grade: measured count: text of the unpacked tree only, no Lean run; declaration counts are regex counts and approximate

sources.recount: hunts/rh_claim_atlas/recount.py, run on the unpacked tree with recount_arguments
sources.ledger: hunts/rh_claim_atlas/ledger_count.py, run on the unpacked tree
sources.reader: hunts/rh_claim_atlas/reader_values.json, used only under the keys reader_value, reader_only and published_namespace_reader_rule

published_namespace.rule: parameterless one-line `def X : Prop :=` inside namespace GlobalTheory.Published or a sub-namespace; closed means a one-line `theorem name : T :=` exists whose T is X, Published.X or GlobalTheory.Published.X

published_namespace_wide_rule.rule: the same count with indentation and attributes tolerated, `section` tracked, any `end` closing the innermost scope and `_root_.` names honoured

strings_rule: fixed strings matched without regard to case; files = files containing the string anywhere
whole_words_rule: case-sensitive whole words on lines that are not import lines; first 16 places listed
